'''Gorvich's private hangar''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] owned by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Gorvich]]. Prior to traveling to [[Reaver Station]], [[Theron Shan]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]], and the smuggler [[Teff'ith]] visited the hangar with Gorvich.<ref name="Annihilation" />
